# link

What the operating system runs when you open a centcom:// link. It always asks first, then opens the matching page in your browser. An invalid link gets one neutral line. Exit codes: 0 opened, 1 the browser could not be opened, 2 invalid link, 3 declined.

```
centcom link <centcom://…>
```
